source: Connected Cloudflare Starry account, account identifier intentionally excluded from public repository
important_limitations: Only one connected Cloudflare account checked. Does not prove other accounts or environments contain no resources.
One discovered D1 database is not classified as approved central Auth/Billing/Battery staging data source; name/account metadata are not proof of purpose or isolation.
A Worker name containing 'preview' does not establish that it is safe, connected to this Git SHA, accessible or actually deployed as an R25 preview.
Script settings GET reported zero bindings for named scripts; this does not exhaust every Worker environment, service binding or external resource.
Current result has not resolved Workers Builds internal external_script_id/script_tag; an empty result from a name-based builds search is not evidence of no build history.
Prior 2026-10-28 R23 incident report #165 independently documented Cloudflare #164 preview build failure (missing previews configuration); no fresh corrective deployment evidence here.
No live user data was read or tested, and no resource was changed.

decision_requests.R25_00: Choose whether to authorize a separately named, isolated, synthetic-only Starry staging environment with a capped budget and no production bindings.
decision_requests.R25_01: Resolve D1 consistency A single authority vs B durable outbox/saga from existing ADR #87 before any data mutation.
decision_requests.R25_02: Name responsible approver for Q104/Q119 retention, P05 signing authority, key custody, cleanup, cost cap and rollback.
